review_text: A great outdoor dining spot right in the city! The ambiance is relaxing, with a cool and welcoming vibe that’s perfect for breakfast or a casual meal. The food was delicious, and while the breakfast prices are on the higher side, they’re reasonable for the quality and overall experience. It’s also pet-friendly, which is a huge plus. Parking is limited, with space for only about five cars inside, so it’s best to arrive early. Overall, a fantastic place—10/10!

This is a nice outdoor café to chill at. I ordered the dirty and it was good. They also have a food truck—we tried the tapa (really good!) and the breakfast steak which was just okay, especially considering it was the most expensive item on the menu. The vibe is relaxed, and when we went around 9 AM, the temperature was cool and comfortable. Overall, a great spot to hang out and enjoy a slow morning.
My husband and I love this coffee place. Really good coffee and friendly barista. It's one of the very few places that opens early at 6am. The place is kept very clean. Way to go Hid'n Coffee.

Service was great, kind, friendly and welcoming, coffee was great the nutty latte had to order 2, food was also great, beef tapa how it should be, the bangus was delicious and the pancakes fluffy and crispy at the same time, that revel ube bar yummm! Definitely recommend

Dining here in the early morning is really worth a try. Their beverage is really tasty, and it's not pricey. Also, they are very accommodating, though they only have a few staff available. However, I don't recommend the place in the late mornings as it gets humid and hot in the area.
Such a delightful spot! I just had a great coffee here. The outside seating is incredibly comfortable. Love the excellent music selection too. Altogether a fantastic, relaxing vibe! Highly recommend.

An awesome find. Now I understand why people recommend this place. The vibe is great. The food is great. We were all stuffed after eating. The coffee is good. There are also small stalls that sell random stuff and trinkets. Definitely a must go if ever you're near the area. They're also conveniently located behind Abreeza.

Great spot for food and coffee! I loved that they have tuyo on the menu—one of my favorite breakfast dishes. The service was excellent, and one of the owners even gave us a slice of cake since it was his birthday yesterday. I’ll definitely come back whenever I’m in Davao.

Definitely among the best coffee shops in Davao City, especially with its laid back open garden atmosphere and its excellent coffee concoctions. I would definitely recommend their Himalayan Salt Latte and Flat White, as well as their PH-origin beans for pour over. Over the weekend, they sometimes invite pop-ups as well. In my recent trip to Davao, I visited this coffee shop at least 6 times.

The first time I visited, I brought my grandma, mom and aunts and they all enjoyed it. Loved the garden feels, though others might find it hot or difficult to eat cause of the low table (though they provide a high tray naman)🪴 Great coffee from Hid’n ☕️ + great breakfast from Before Weekend. 🥞 What more can you ask for? Will be back for sure!
The dirty coffee was excellent! The location is also very quiet, making it a great place for anyone who wants to relax and unwind. Highly recommended.
Our fave go-to bfast spot on a gloomy Sunday morning. Their tapsilog is a must try. ++ pet friendly really a plus. Just the wait time usuall takes longer (up to 45mins to an hour) esp on weekends

Nestled quitely along the busy street of N. Torres is the @hidncoffeedvo 🍵 A trendy coffeeshop with its food truck concept, the place offers a cozy setting for meet ups and bonding time with loved ones. I ordered a calming Matcha Latte, safe to say it was really good. We dropped by around 7pm-ish on a Friday night, a bit disappointed that all their pasta, sandwich, and cookies were sold out...must be that good. 😋 📍Palm Village, Nicasio Torres St, Obrero, Davao City 🔆 Opens at 6am, closes at 9pm. ☕️ A regular Matcha Latte and Cappuccino costs P250 in total.

The place is great! Very refreshing mahangin and alot of greens to see. Plus the ice caramel is soo good. Recommended talaga! We ordered the filipino platter as well masarap din naman. I only gave 4 stars since medyo mainit na sya when wen there around 730 am. So we hope to have more protection sa sun hehe. But overall very nice place!!

alfresco dining thats open conveniently for breakfast. has 2 stall selections. the other has good and various coffee selection while the othef mostly has food and group breakfast ones. the coffee portion was quite small and the toast isnt really served hot, it was a bit cold to touch but both still tasted fine.

I like their coffee nook concept ♡ the iced caramel and peanut butter chocolate cookie from Ana Banana's bakery that I ordered were also delicious. Also, my suggestion to come here is at around 4:00 PM because it's pretty to take pictures and it's not too hot to hang out with your friends etc. ☺️

Durian latte, anyone? If you’re in Davao, you’ve got to check out Hid’n Coffee! This mobile café is a hidden gem serving a surprisingly balanced Durian Latte. The durian perfectly complements the coffee without being too strong—just the right amount of boldness. Definitely a must-try for anyone looking for something new in their coffee experience. Follow my IG: @coffeewithjayr, for more cafe recommendations
Really good coffee! I had 2 cups in one seating. It's that good! Will definitely recommend this place, and will drop by again once I go back to Davao.

Cute place. First time to go on Easter Sunday! Traveled to Davao and Planned to just try the coffee but figured out they had an Easter event for the kids, so we came back with the kids! Coffee was good, Before Weekend food was gooood tooo! Excited to go back soon! 💜
One of Davao’s go-to for coffee. While people go gaga about Spanish Latte, I’d recommend their Iced Americano 👌🏼 They also have non-coffee options: Pink Milk, Milo Dino, and House Iced Tea.

Visited this place x number of times and I love love how the mood changes throughout the day. I mean, thanks Mother Earth! Order your favorite coffee and matcha, you wont regret it! :) Free parking, good drinks, cashless payment option, clean CR

We were brought here as part of the hospitality tour by our friends from Holodeck Productions and we really enjoyed our drinks! I got one of their iced peanut butter lattes and the flavors were well balanced, the nutty flavor didn't overpower the taste of the coffee. They also serve funky stuff like Durian Affogato. The place was also very breezy and comfy.
It's hid'n, so for the love of your palate, please find this place! Ordered a set meal that's good for four but devoured by two - it's not the serving size, but the taste!
Simple dining experience with superb customer service. I do hope they continue with the quality of service they offer as they grow and expand. Food is delicious. The drinka are mouth-watering.

The coffee was good, we ordered the matcha latte and the spanish latte. Both coffee was to our liking. Ambiance had a cozy feels to it with a decent amount of tables and chairs. Place was instagrammable with warm lighting at night. The only problem was the parking and one way entrance and exit.

This cute little hidden gem was such an awesome find! They have signature espresso drinks along with your usual cafe findings. Service was prompt and kind. We got the durian latte (a must if you like durian) and the milo espresso drink. Would definitely come back!

NOT RECOMMENDED, FLIES ARE EVERYWHERE WE ASKED FOR ADDITIONAL CANDLE BUT THEY SAID THEY CAN ONLY PROVIDE 1 CANDLE PER TABLE TOLD THEM WE WILL BE OCCUPYING 2 TABLES BUT THEY JUST IGNORED US. ITS OUR 3RD TIME HERE BUT DILI NA MAKAYA ANG LANGAW.
If you're searching for a quality coffee and great vibes this place is a most visit.
Stopped by here after an errand and got the Dirty Matcha Tea and hung out and did some reading. Drink was great, had WiFi, friendly staff and cool outdoor atmosphere.
i love their focaccia. drinks and food are affordable and delicious. place is quiet and really private. staff are very friendly.
Staff are awesome. Coffee priced reasonably and taste good. Place is instagramable! ❤️❤️❤️⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It’s like having coffee in your garden. It’s an open space so if it’s hot, I might not visit here. But they open early at 6am. And they sell breakfast and coffee, so it’s actually a great place for breakfast. I visited in a cloudy afternoon. So I was very comfortable with my iced milo coffee and a chorizo wrap. I would want to try their salmon next time, and their rice meals.

Very nice place actually. We had trouble finding it but when we reached there the place is very nice. Good service. Good food. Good people. Could've stayed longer if I hadn't had any other appointment.
This not so hidn spot serves good coffee and there's also an all-day breakfast in the same location. 🫰🏼
If you're a coffee and chill vibe connoisseur, this is your place, these are your people. Outdoor food cart pod style, breakfast was good too. My go to spot in Davao.

Limited parking space. Limited coffee and pastry selection. The Iced Espressos are good though. I find the place too warm to hang out. Seeing their operating times have changed I might drop by again — to try the neighboring cart. The heat was just unbearable to stay longer.
Nice, quiet place for coffee and breakfast tucked in a literally “hid’n” area. The service and atmosphere was good, just wish there were more food and drinks available to choose from. 😊
Refreshing outdoor coffee experience. Poor parking space though.
Ordered iced tea, so refreshing!

love their coffee. I've tried their milo dinosaur, spanish latte, milo espresso and strawberry iced tea, and I love them all! the other food truck in their compound also offers breakfast items. perfect combination for brunch
My new favourite place to get espresso You should come See you there
Chill place... Good food... And there're some small shops as well that sell clothes or other stuff
Really perfect place hidden within the heart of northern part Davao poblacion. Amazing food matched with great coffee and very hospitable service.
this is outdoors under a shady tree. breakfast available, and no local coffees that i saw.
Cozy place. Relaxing. Excellent customer service. A good place to unwind.

This place gives you the experience of outdoor styles and experience out of the city it's just a walking distance at Abreeza Mall and Aeon Tower and Abreeza condos. This place resides at the very heart of the City Clean and peace Environment
No wonder it stays hidden... everybody thought we said Eden. Coffe is great. Place is nice and quiet. Not sure if its hidden or hidin' but you will definitely disappear.
Great coffee and cool and relaxing atmosphere. Salamat kaayo!
Best Coffe in Davao!!

Food and customer service is good the only lacking is the place...felt like abandoned park or something...needs more polishing here and there but overall nice escape spot for the bustling of the metro davao
Great out door cafe with lots of charm and good food
Most affordable plantbased mylk upgrade in the city. Lovely owners. Great place to hangout with friends.
Best place. Calm.chill.relax.great services and great crew. Great coffee. You can park your car
Good coffee place in the city center! 😍😍😍😍
Really like this place. Shadow to sit. Good food and drinks. And a parking spot.
One of the best in the Philippines. Excellent service, coffee and food.
Great vibe and great food
Cheap! I love their milocyrus hehe
Place is cozy 💚
parking here is too tight but the food here is worth it.
Everything is perfect here
Strong coffee. Nice vibe.
Best coffee spot in davao
A little too expensive
Matcha!!
Good coffee

2 restaurant share food and coffee. We had a great western breakfast. It was so much we could not eat it all, for nice price. sausage, bacon, eggs, pancake, mango. The coffee and passion fruit juice where also good, we will come back

Food and ambience was good. My only issue really was how understaffed it was. There was around 2-3 people at most. 1 tending to the coffee and 2 tending to the food. So they also clean the tables, manage parking, take, and prepare orders. Our family order came one at a time with an interval of 15-20 mins in between. Our coffee order was almost completely forgotten

Starting the day right with a cozy cafe vibe and the perfect breakfast. Highly recommend! Made better by great food and an even better cafe. This cafe knows how to do breakfast right. A warm cup, a tasty plate, and a cafe worth sharing about. Perfect breakfast spot! Breakfast that deserves a shout‑out. Loved the food, loved the place.
Great coffee.

The grounds are quiet and cool, with plenty of shade from the trees, making it a relaxing place. The durian coffee is on the sweeter side, but I think there are few places in Davao where you can drink it, so you should definitely try it. The fact that it opens at 6 AM is also a plus.

Hid'n coffee is a cafe I would recommend going to, Such a vibe!!! I love the iced matcha latté! for only P130 the price is really worth it, it's so delicious and you can really taste the true taste of matcha if there's a little bit of sweetness in the cream and you can still taste the matcha! This hidden gem café is a must visit in Davao. The price is so cheap and the location is just chill and easy to find. You'll definitely come back when you're here. Great service from the baristas! 🍵💚 It's so worth it to visit, the asthetic of the place is relaxing.
Comfortable seating area. The Spanish latte tastes average. The roasting could be better.
Lots of parking area. The americano and matcha are delicious.
The coffee is delicious, would you like to drink it here too?
